headline: Presses on the Hub now save themselves, and one Update saves them and rebuilds the page, so Apply and Refresh are gone and a later Go reads Update now. One Hub Morning run does your inbox, meeting prep, the first update and your morning brief, in place of Hub Prep, Hub Inbox and the Morning Brief chat. Set-up asks you to allow or skip each live source, and with Google Calendar, Today stays live while the page is open. Each meeting's follow-up is drafted after it and waits for one press. After updating, say "update my hub" once and reload the Hub tab.
